title: Suggestions Decision Inventory
description: Hand-written registry of every editable decision the suggestions markdown offers (spec 038 ADR-7). One row per decision, joined in both directions against suggestions-wire.schema.json's `Editable`-marked fields and against the parser's recognised controls (T1.2). A row's `id` is opaque and never changes when a control's label is reworded — the consumer's join sees an edit, not a delete plus an add.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel. Always 1 for this revision.

decisions.description: One entry per editable decision the suggestions markdown offers. A decision that is read-only never appears. A control that has been retired keeps its row with editable=false, so a consumer still vendoring it is told to remove their control rather than left writing a field no longer honoured.

items.$comment: A retired control (editable: false) has no live match site left to name, so parser_label cannot be required unconditionally — that would reject exactly the row the editable:false column exists to carry. No row is currently editable:false, but that is a fact about today's data, not a reason to simplify this conditional away.

id.description: Stable, opaque row id (e.g. 'D01'). Never derived from markdown_control's prose and never changes when that prose is reworded — the consumer's join keys on this, not on the label.

markdown_control.description: Human-readable description of the control on the suggestions markdown (checkbox, field line, or line-edit) that makes this decision editable. Prose, for humans — not machine-matched.

wire_field.description: Dotted path (array segments suffixed '[]') to the field on suggestions-wire.schema.json this decision writes, e.g. 'suggestions[].title'. Null when the decision has no wire field yet — recorded explicitly rather than omitting the row (F4).

editable.description: True while the markdown still offers this control. False marks a retired control whose row is kept for consumer migration rather than deleted.

parser_label.description: The literal strings suggestion-parser.py compares against to recognise this decision — many-to-one: one decision can fire on several literals (e.g. a checkbox matched by either of two words, or a field line with several accepted key aliases). Required while editable is true; absent when editable is false, since a retired control has no live match site left to name.

note.description: Optional free-text context — why wire_field is null, a schema/parser discrepancy, or retirement rationale. Omitted when there is nothing to add.
